sources.title: Introducing Breeze TTS 2 - breezeblue.ai
sources.snippet: Breeze TTS 2 brings natural-language voice design, voice direction for any voice, and low-latency streaming generation together in a single model. Built for the next generation of real-time voice AI, it enables users to design any voice, direct every performance, and bring it to life in real time.
